description.value: Amplified Cafe is a specialty coffee destination founded in 2015 by Daniel Houghton, located adjacent to the Kamloops Downtown Library in the heart of downtown. The cafe serves meticulously crafted coffee alongside food sourced from a curated roster of local BC suppliers including Gold Leaf Patisseries, Black Salt Catering, and Blackwell Dairy. It also roasts and sells its own beans, giving cyclists a place to both refuel and stock up.
